newsitem.title: USA: Sun Microsystems third-quarter profit rises 38 pecent.
newsitem.headline: Sun Microsystems third-quarter profit rises 38 pecent.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc. said Tuesday its fiscal third-quarter profit from operations rose 38 percent, better than most analysts expected, on strong sales of its computers.

Sun, a maker of computers that control the flow of information through networks, said profit from operations rose to $184.2 million, or 51 cents a share, compared with net income of $143.3 million, or 37 cents, in the same quarter a year ago.
Wall Street expected Sun, based in Mountain View, Calif., to report profit from operations of 47 cents, according to a recent analyst survey by Zacks Investment Research.
With a $62.2 million gain from the sale of securities and a $22.9 million charge for an acquisition, Sun reported net income of $223.5 million, or 58 cents a share.
Third-quarter revenue rose 15 percent to $2.11 billion from $1.84 billion a year ago.
